title: Math for AI
description: A survey of the mathematics behind machine learning and AI (linear algebra, calculus, statistics and probability), with each idea implemented in Python.
stagesNote: The weeks are grouped by subject. The first two build the Python needed for the rest.

text.lessons: The full text for each topic, grouped by week. Each week ends with its lab. Most lessons link to a Colab notebook that holds the code from the lesson.
text.slides: One deck per topic. Use the arrow keys to move through a deck, press F for full screen, and press Esc to come back to this page.
text.resources: The Colab notebooks, videos, and outside references that go with each week. Everything is free.

topics: Implementation of gradient ascent and descent
Training a model with gradient descent
Calculating the output of a neural network

weeks.topic: Continuous random variables and probabilistic models

demos.name: Loop and sum tracer
demos.about: Step through a for loop one line at a time and watch a sigma-notation sum build up term by term.

demos.name: Matrix transformation explorer
demos.about: Change a 2 × 2 matrix and see how it moves the plane, what its determinant measures, and which directions are eigenvectors.

demos.name: Vector similarity explorer
demos.about: Drag two vectors to see their lengths, dot product, distance, and cosine similarity, then find the nearest words in a small set of embeddings.

demos.name: Line-fitting lab
demos.about: Fit a line to data by hand, see the squared errors as squares, and compare your line with the least-squares line.

demos.name: Derivative explorer
demos.about: Watch a secant line turn into a tangent line as two points move together, and read the derivative as a slope.

demos.name: Softmax and temperature
demos.about: Turn scores into probabilities, change the temperature, and sample the next word to see how the setting changes what is chosen.

demos.name: Gradient descent stepper
demos.about: Take gradient descent one step at a time on functions of one and two inputs, and see what the learning rate does.

demos.name: Dice and probability simulator
demos.about: Run a random experiment thousands of times and watch the observed shares settle onto the probabilities.

demos.name: Distribution explorer
demos.about: Shade an interval under a normal, uniform, or exponential density curve and read the probability as an area.

demos.name: Attention explorer
demos.about: Move token vectors around and watch the attention scores, weights, and blended output change.

demos.name: Bigram text generator
demos.about: Train a tiny language model by counting word pairs, then generate text one word at a time and read its perplexity.
